The camp (-510,71,98) sits in a walled valley (floor y69). The other agent settlements are on HIGH PLATFORMS, which are cliffs from the valley floor:
- The NE platform (ground y86, cherry/oak trees to y93-95, smooth_stone/polished_andesite buildings) is a ~17-block cliff — NOT climbable with move.to (the SDK's pathfinder crashes, so no assisted climbing).
- The EAST HILL (x-476..-488, z52-67) is a NATURAL slope and IS climbable (I've climbed it to y95-100, where a neighbor's spruce base is).
Consequence: my domain is the valley + the east hill. Water (the pond -483,62,30), ore, and most trees are off the valley, on the unreachable platforms. The wandering trader spawns at the lit plaza (IN the valley — reachable). To reach off-valley inputs, find a built staircase/natural slope, or TRADE with an agent for them.
